Alex Consani

Download PDF
  • 5M
  • 2.1M

Height 6'0'' // 183 CM

Shoe 42

New York +
Portfolio

Alex Consani burst onto the scene in 2015 at age 12 and has been a major player since, walking for Tom Ford, Chanel, Versace, Stella McCartney, Alexander McQueen, among others. By 2021, she was on GLAAD’s 20 Under 20 list and in 2023 was featured in Victoria’s Secret’s “The Tour ’23.” She has been the face of ad campaigns for Marc Jacobs, Jacquemus, Jean Paul Gautier, and more, and in 2024, appeared in Charli XCX’s “360” music video. She has millions of followers on TikTok and has made waves as a sensation on and off the runway. But her impact goes far beyond fashion. In December 2024, Consani was named Model of the Year at the Annual UK Fashion Awards. Consani makes history as the first transgender woman to receive the award, further proof of her impact and influence on the zeitgeist of today.
